औशन,
औशनस a. (-नी, -सी f.) [उशनस्-अण्] Belonging or peculiar to Uśanas; originating from Uśanas, or taught by him; पितामहाद्वरं लेभे सर्वमौशनसं धनम् [[

.]] 
-सम् 
__1 The law-book of उशनस् (a treatise on civil polity). 
__2 N. of an Upapurāṇa. 
-साः N. of a school of writers on the science of government mentioned by Kauṭilya; [[Kau.

.]] 
-सी N. of Devayanī; तं वीरमाहौशनसी प्रेमनिर्भरया गिरा [[

[उषण्-अण्] 
__1 Pungency. 
__2 Black pepper. 
-Comp. 
-शौण्डी dried ginger; black pepper.

a. (-धी f.) [औषधि-अण्] Consisting of herbs. 
-धम् 
__1 A herb; herbs taken collectively. 
__2 A medicament, medicinal drug, medicine in general. 
__3 A vessel for herbs. 
__4 A mineral. 
__5 N. of Viṣṇu. 
__6 Counter-action, prevention; अतिकुधं निषधमनौषधं जनः [[Śi. 17. 7.]] 
-Comp. 
-पेषकः One who grinds or pounds medicaments.

औषधिः,
 
-धी f. 
__1 A herb, plant (in general); [[

]] v. l.; see ओषधि. 
__2 A medicinal herb; अचिन्त्यो हि मणिमन्त्रौषधीनां प्रभावः [[
Ratn. 2

.]] 
__3 An herb which emits fire; विरमन्ति न ज्वलितुमौषधयः [[
]] (तृणज्योतींषि [[Malli.]]); cf. [[

.]] 
__4 An annual or deciduous plant; °धीपतिः N. of Soma, the lord of plants. 
-पञ्चप्रकाराः (1) Juice of a green herb (रस). (2) Powder [Page0513-2] of dry medicinal billets चूर्ण. (3) Decoction of medicinal herbs (कषाय). (4) Decoction mixed with medicinal powder (अवलेह). (5) A medicine to be pounded like condiment (कल्क). -पञ्चामृतं गुडूची, गोक्षुर, मुसली, मुण्डी, शतावरी. 
-प्रतिनिधिः A substitute for a herb which cannot be secured.
€8U. To reduce to a medicament.
a. Medicinal, consisting of herbs.

a. Sacred to Uṣas or the dawn.
